run_compute_structure_matches: run structure matching evaluation on all predicted crystal structures in a directory against experimental references
run_evaluate_structures_file: run evaluation of predicted crystal structures in a parquet file against experimental reference structures
run_match_structures: run comparison of a single predicted crystal structure against experimental reference structures using CSD or pymatgen
run_load_target_structures: run loading of experimental reference crystal structures from CIF files into memory for evaluation
run_get_eval_config_and_method: run extraction of evaluation configuration and method from a config dictionary for crystal structure evaluation
